Maybe your "special connection" is just your brain picking up on patterns humans have been obsessed with for millennia—love, power, spirituality… all hammered into steel! 🧪⚡ (P.S. Are you *sure* you’re not a reincarnated blacksmith from the Renaissance? 🧙♂️✨)</response>
